verdict.rationale: Payout timing and accelerated payouts are a fair question for a POS that processes card payments, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions payout schedules, payout visibility, or next-day or instant payout options. The only payment-related items cover Tap to Pay and transaction fees, which are not payouts.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
